51267.author: CMS-L1T-Jet-Tagging
51267.body:
#### PR description:

This PR updates the Phase 2 L1TNGJet model wrapper to be more generic. Major changes include:
 - Removal of specific datatype input and output arrays and replacement with input and output structs that take any number of input and output arrays with a generic input type. The selection of these features is done inside the model emulator itself
 - Additional constants for number of inputs and outputs 
 - Splitting of NNVectorVar into Candidate vectors and Jet vectors
 - Additional processing of the input and output structs, filling them with 0s and passing to the model

This PR needs to be merged alongside [this](https://github.com/cms-sw/cmsdist/pull/10667) cms-dist PR as it will cause bad any cast errors without this update

This PR does not change model performance, the cms-dist PR updates the emulator model wrapper only and not the model  itself, outputs of the model are expected to remain constant

#### PR validation:

This PR is verified in this pipeline with specific plots measuring emulator / hls4ml matching [here](https://cms-l1t-jet-tagger.web.cern.ch/TrainTagger/branches/generic-emulator-update/baseline_5param_extended_trk/latest/plots/emulation/)

Code check and formats are applied
51267.title: Add generic emulator wrapper for NGJet

51943.author: sbein
51943.body:
This PR induces FastSim to adopt the jet refiner based on training with Run 2024 conditions. Previously, the default for 2024 was to use the 2022-trained refinement. 

Also new: jets without an available, pT PAT gen-jet match or with gen-pT <10 GeV remain unrefined. Also, the refinement now derives CvB analytically for DeepJet and UParT to preserve unitarity, rather than implementing this via an MDMM constraint. 

The changes depend on the companion cms-data PR: https://github.com/cms-data/PhysicsTools-NanoAOD/pull/21

Training results/comparisons: [T1tttt-derived triplets](https://www.desy.de/~beinsam/FastSim/Refinement/FastPerfekt_UnitaryShapeBest150_20260918/index.html),
Independent validation [ttbar new](https://www.desy.de/~beinsam/FastSim/Refinement/TTbarRun3PU2024_PairedMiniAODN200k_FixedLinks_UnitaryShapeBest150_GenPt10Mask_20260921/index.html), [ttbar previous](https://www.desy.de/~beinsam/FastSim/Refinement/TTbarRun3PU2024_PairedMiniAODN200k_FixedLinks_UnitaryReheatBest734_GenPt10Mask_20260921/index.html),[T1tttt](https://www.desy.de/~beinsam/FastSim/Refinement/T1ttttRun3PU2024_InclusiveN20k_FixedLinks_UnitaryShapeBest150_GenPt10Mask_20260918/index.html).

Both PR's are needed to proceed with 2024 NANOv15 and re-NANOv15.
51943.title: FastSim jet refinement tuned on 2024

51957.author: jprendi
51957.body:
#### PR description:

This PR:

1) separates `hltScoutingDqmOffline` into `hltDqmScoutingAndReco` and `hltDqmOnlyScouting`, such that we could run `hltDqmOnlyScouting` for offline DQM analysis on HLT Scouting Collections without needing prompt results

2) introduces `onlinehlt4vector`, such that we can run the online hlt dqm client in an offline analysis

#### PR validation:

This PR was prepared in `CMSSW_17_0_X_2026-09-20-0000`. We can now run the workflows for example like:

```
cmsDriver.py step2 -s DQM:hltDqmOnlyScouting \
	     --conditions 160X_dataRun3_NGT_v6 \
             --datatier DQMIO \
             -n 100 \
             --eventcontent DQMIO \
             --geometry DB:Extended \
             --era Run3_2026 \
             --filein $ALL_FILES \
             --fileout file:step2.root \
             --nThreads 24 \
             --python_filename dqm.py \
             --no_exec
```

and 

```
cmsDriver.py step2 -s DQM:onlinehlt4vector \
	     --conditions 160X_dataRun3_NGT_v6 \
             --datatier DQMIO \
             -n 100 \
             --eventcontent DQMIO \
             --geometry DB:Extended \
             --era Run3_2026 \
             --filein $ALL_FILES \
             --fileout file:step2.root \
             --nThreads 24 \
             --python_filename dqm.py \
             --no_exec
```

with the subsequent standard harvesting.

51994.author: BenjaminRS
51994.body: backport of #51975 The original PR was: https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50908. I have commandeered it as the original author has now left CMS. No other changes were needed in order for this to come into CMSSW 17X This is the original PR description: Added valid bit to TkJetWord object TkJetWord now contains 64 bits of data as opposed to 63 before Changed track jet ordering on readout to GTT pattern file to reflect the same order as the firmware (was sorted by pT before, now sorted first by phi then by eta) Added extra output file when running createFirmwareInputFiles_cfg.py called FirmwareGeometryFile.vh. If any of the JetFinding parameters change like eta bin centers or cuts on track multiplicity, regenerate FirmwareGeometryFile.vh and place it in the /algo/components/jet/firmware/hdl/ directory of the JetFinding firmware. Presentation of changes in a talk coming soon #### PR validation: Original validation: * Valid bit present in track jet words in GTT test vector files * Used FirmwareGeometryFile.vh in the firmware and checked emulator test vector output against firmware. They match. New validation: Ran: * scram b distclean * scram b -j 8 * scram build code-checks * scram build code-format The L1T Menu team saw that the TkJet Performance changed with this PR. [I ran a validation to confirm that this was due to changing the minimum track pT for the tracks considered in the TkJet to 10 GeV](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1728721/#10-tracks-vertex). This is required to match the current FW.

52058.author: Jared-Fraticelli
52058.body:
Backport of the W3Pi track-triplet emulation and GTT test-vector changes. Identical to the master PR except that TkTripletWord keeps the plain l1t namespace, since CMSSW_17_0_X predates the io_v1 dataformat migration.

#### PR description:

Backport of the W3Pi track-triplet emulation and GTT test-vector changes from #49003 to CMSSW_17_0_X.

The TkTripletWord is updated to contain a valid bit, triplet pT, eta, and phi fields (currently set to 0 until the firmware defines their encoding), the triplet invariant mass, the three triplet track pTs, and a charge bit. The track-triplet emulation plugin finds the three highest-pT tracks in an event, computes the invariant mass, and fills the output word, which spans two 64-bit link words in the GTT OutputToGlobalTrigger test vectors. The L1Nano triplet table is updated to match the new word content.

The content is identical to the master PR except that TkTripletWord keeps the plain l1t namespace, since CMSSW_17_0_X predates the io_v1 dataformat migration.

See https://indico.cern.ch/event/1588031/ for a talk on the W->3pi updates.

#### PR validation:

Compiled and tested in CMSSW_17_0_0_pre5 on top of the current CMSSW_17_0_X branch: the GTT test-vector workflow (L1Trigger/DemonstratorTools/test/gtt/createFirmwareInputFiles_cfg.py) runs unmodified, the triplet word is correctly written to the output test vectors, and the L1Nano triplet table fills with values consistent with the test vectors, using a CMSSW_17_0_0_pre1 Phase-2 RelVal (RelValTTbarToDilepton_14TeV, D121, noPU) as input.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Backport of #49003 to CMSSW_17_0_X, requested by L1T for Phase-2 GTT firmware development in the 17_0_X cycle.
52058.title: W3Pi emulation and test vectors (backport of #49003 to CMSSW_17_0_X)
